chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl, from Aḥmad ibn al-Naḍr, from al-Ḥuṣayn ibn ʿAmr, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab: that Muʿāwiyah - may Allah curse him - wrote to Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī that Ibn Abī al-Jasrayn found a man with his wife and killed him, and judgment regarding it had become unclear to me, so ask ʿAlī about this matter for me. He said:

Abū Mūsā said: I met ʿAlī, and ʿAlī said: “By Allah, this is not in these lands,” meaning al-Kūfah, “nor has this occurred in my presence, so from where did this come to you?” I said: Muʿāwiyah - may Allah curse him - wrote to me that Ibn Abī al-Jasrayn found a man with his wife and killed him, and judgment concerning it had become unclear to him, so what is your view regarding this? He said: “I am Abū al-Ḥasan: if he brings four witnesses testifying to what he witnessed, otherwise he is to be handed over with his rope.”

key_terms.الْقَضَاءُ: judicial ruling or legal judgment in the case
key_terms.امْرَأَتِهِ: his wife, the woman involved in the incident
key_terms.بِأَرْبَعَةٍ: with four witnesses, the required legal proof
key_terms.بِرُمَّتِهِ: with his rope, meaning he is handed over bound for legal process
key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: this matter, referring to the legal case under inquiry
key_terms.يَشْهَدُونَ: they testify, meaning they give legal witness testimony

ai.seo_question: What was Imam ʿAlī’s ruling when a man killed someone he found with his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question sent to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning a man who killed another after finding him with his wife. Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام ruled that the killer must produce four witnesses to the act he claims to have seen; otherwise, he is to be surrendered for legal liability. The report reflects the strict evidentiary standards in judicial rulings involving illicit sexual conduct and homicide.
